subQuests.subQuestName: Head to the deepest part of The Chasm

130271001.text: So that elemental life-form came all the way here on its own and spent a long time by itself?

130271002.text: Wouldn't it already have become The Withering like the others...?

130271003.text: There is a chance that it could avoid that end, using the power of something here...

130271004.text: I'm referring to what was used to fight against the Abyss. It once repaired the rifts of Teyvat long ago.

130271005.text: It has the ability to purify and stabilize powers that shouldn't exist in Teyvat.

130271006.text: Forbidden knowledge that its light has shone upon is kept here forever in a different form...

130271008.text: Yup. It's just like soap bubbles that rise to the water's surface.

130271009.text: Uh, another strange metaphor... But Paimon somehow gets this one.

130271010.text: What the Lord of Dendro means is that the apocalypse was altered by the power of the giant spike and hidden within the Oozing Filth.

130271011.text: Yes, and it shouldn't be far from here. Let's go and take a look.

subQuests.subQuestName: Head to the deepest part of The Chasm
Defeat the monsters and destroy the "Oozing Concretions"

130270201.text: We won't be able to see anything if we keep going that way.

130270203.text: We've found it... Apep, the Dendro Dragon.

130270204.text: Paimon knew it would be big, but... not THAT big!

130270205.text: Puny god, puny human... Leave my domain.

130270206.text: Frail life-forms like you cannot survive in the endless sands of the desert.

130270207.text: Apep, we're here to save you.

130270208.text: I do not need saving. Especially not by you, Buer.

130270209.text: You are no different from Amun. Both of you have only existed for a fraction of what you know as time, yet you call yourselves lords of this land by leaning on the heavens' glow.

130270210.text: You're better off paying attention to your path ahead, as you will fall where you've fallen before.

130270211.text: I know that you hate both gods and humans, but you've grown too weak now. Can't you let go of your hatred, even for only a moment?

130270212.text: Let go... for only a moment?

130270213.text: Foolish Buer. You will find no gratefulness from me, even if you heal me.

130270214.text: You will only be reviving the dragon that will destroy Sumeru and the seven nations!

130270216.text: That I am. Time will bring death to all, it's unavoidable. Although I am gravely ill, my mind remains clear.

130270217.text: I am different from the ancient dragons that came to terms with you!

130270218.text: There's no need for this. There is no point in fighting, what we need is the truth.

130270219.text: Hmph. "The truth"... the shackles that the God of Wisdom cannot escape from.

130270220.text: I have paid dearly for the truth, and you shall do the same soon enough.

130270223.text: Wahh! What is that? Paimon's never seen that before!

130270225.text: Huh? They're your family too!? But they don't look anything like Fungi!

130270226.text: External form... not important. Inner nature... same.

130270227.text: The composition of their elemental power is identical to ours. In other words, they're residents of our homeland.

130270228.text: Is this what they've become after experiencing the apocalypse?

130270229.text: This is also a form of adaptation, although a most gruesome and pitiful one. Many of our family members never made it out of the Dendro Dragon...

130270230.text: They've gradually taken this form in order to survive the apocalypse.

130270231.text: Is there any way to avoid fighting them?

130270232.text: Hey, can you guys talk? We're here to rescue you!

130270235.text: They've given it their all just to survive.

130270236.text: They're being drawn by the Fire Seed. Only its power can temporarily free them from their pain.

130270237.text: All that remains are the instincts to survive and search for energy needed to do so. Everything else has been discarded in the process of adaptation.

130270238.text: So this is the result of forbidden knowledge...

130270239.text: Would our world become the same if the forbidden knowledge was allowed to rampage across Teyvat...?

130270240.text: Like fish struggling on land... unable to find a single puddle of fresh water in the entire world...

130270243.text: Yes. But please, try to be gentle with them. They are not evil in nature... All they want to do is survive.

subQuests.subQuestName: Speak with the new elemental life-form

130270101.text: We finally managed to rescue it...

130270102.text: It should be the life-form from the prophecy.

130270105.text: Wait, something dark is coming out... Something's not right!

130270107.text: What's going on? Didn't Nahida say it was purified?

130270108.text: Maybe it's because such a long amount of time has passed.

130270109.text: Although the power of the Oozing Filth is more stable than that of the apocalypse, it is still a form of dangerous power.

130270110.text: It might have lost its mind after being soaked in it for such a long time.

130270111.text: Oh no... but we still have tons of questions we need to ask.

130270112.text: I should be able to purge it with my elemental power.

130270115.text: But this is our only chance.

130270116.text: I said no, and I mean it.

130270117.text: We can't go through that again.

130270119.text: I'm sorry, I got a little anxious.

130270120.text: It's okay... I trust your judgment. I was being a little hasty myself. Let's see if we can think of another way.

130270122.text: Oh, yeah! You said that the elemental power in the crystal was identical to theirs.

130270123.text: You want to use its power? But...

130270124.text: The Lord of Dendro seems hesitant. I too, would advise caution.

130270125.text: It's risky to use its power without fully understanding its intended use.

130270126.text: Don't understand. This no good... That no good... Save life... important.

130270127.text: Yes, I understand, but this is our only chance to return home. We cannot afford to be careless.

130270128.text: It's okay, there's no need to argue. I'll think of something to do about the elemental power that will be used.

130270129.text: #Hmm, how about this... {NICKNAME}, you could try using it.

130270130.text: I understand that you have an amazing resistance to forbidden knowledge.

130270132.text: #Don't overdo it, {NICKNAME}. Paimon will be worried!

130270135.text: Lord of Dendro... and you others... How long... How long have I been waiting here?

130270137.text: The Lord of Dendro, here in person... Does that mean... the apocalypse has come to an end?

130270138.text: Wait, did you... get smaller again?

130270139.text: I'm sorry, that portion of my memory is highly unreliable at the moment... I can't seem to remember who you are...

130270140.text: Hmm, that sounds about right. After all, the purpose of my existence is precisely for those "unreliable" memories you speak of.

130270141.text: You once said that the apocalypse will be completely eradicated and that relevant memories will become unstable.

130270142.text: Even you couldn't promise that you'd remember our agreement after those events take place.

130270143.text: However, you are definitely someone who stays true to your word. My sacrifice is nothing compared to your resolve.

130270144.text: You and I made the agreement?

130270145.text: Yes. You used your power to protect me. That is the reason why I was able to survive here.

130270146.text: To be honest, I'm nearing my end... I had thought I'd be stronger than this.

130270147.text: No one can withstand the power of the apocalypse.

130270148.text: In order to preserve a somewhat stable memory, I had to change the power of the apocalypse into a different form.

130270149.text: Only the giant spike that fell from the sky was capable of doing something like that. But the moment I chose to go through with it...

130270150.text: Is the moment I lost my chance of being rescued by the Lord of Dendro...

130270151.text: But enough about me. Lord of Dendro, let's get to the important matter at hand. As you can see... I won't last much longer...

130270152.text: I understand, and I'm sorry. But...

130270153.text: Can you please tell me what this is?

130270154.text: This... is a Fire Seed. It's an essential item for saving the Dendro Dragon. Thankfully, it appears to be in good condition.

130270155.text: The Lord of Dendro and our people created this item together. It mimics how the Dendro Dragon's "Heart of Oasis" operates.

130270156.text: The Dendro Dragon has been tormented by the apocalypse for far too long. It too is nearing the end of its power.

130270157.text: However, if you are able to reactivate its Heart of Oasis using the Fire Seed, then the Dendro Dragon will begin to recover.

130270158.text: And as a result, our homeland will return to the way it once was.

130270159.text: So the Heart of Oasis is Apep's source of power...

130270160.text: No wonder the crystal was able to heal this Fungus just now. That's what it's used for.

130270162.text: You used... the Fire Seed to save me?

130270164.text: That's... Uh, never mind, it's not your fault. You didn't know.

130270165.text: The Fire Seed contains a high concentration of elemental power inside of it. It's very powerful yet fragile at the same time.

130270166.text: It is not stable in its current form. To prevent any accidents, please don't use it again.

130270167.text: Since I am its creator, I will take responsibility for it. I assure you there's no need to worry.

130270168.text: Alright. Aside from being able to heal the Dendro Dragon, the Fire Seed can also resonate with the Heart of Oasis.

130270169.text: In other words, you'll be able to find the Dendro Dragon by following the guidance of the Fire Seed.

130270170.text: But you should hurry, there is little time to waste.

130270172.text: Forget about me. You should hurry home now.

130270173.text: Everyone is returning home, including you.

130270174.text: As I told you, I've already lost my chance to be saved by the Lord of Dendro.

130270175.text: Lord of Dendro, I thank you for coming to find me and for being willing to save the Dendro Dragon.

130270176.text: Our past has been saved, and our future has been ensured.

130270177.text: It's enough for me just knowing that they will return home.

130270180.text: Can you use the Lumenstone once more? I can still feel its elemental power.

130270181.text: Please... Of all of us, it deserves the chance to return home the most.

130270183.text: This is a small ball of light that it left behind...

130270184.text: I can feel it... I can feel its knowledge and emotions... It has all returned to its original elemental form and is becoming one with the other family members.

130270185.text: Do not be sad, my friends. Its wish has come true and it's very happy right now.

130270186.text: Because its external form doesn't matter, right?

130270187.text: Yes, because our external form does not matter, and our home has been saved. There is nothing more important than being together with family.

subQuests.subQuestName: Follow the directions and head to Sumeru's desert region

130279904.text: It's not much further. Follow me, we're close now.

130270602.text: That should be the Heart of Oasis. All we need to do is "light" it with the Fire Seed and it'll restore Apep with elemental power.

130270603.text: The damage it suffered internally will also slowly begin to heal.

130270604.text: #Then let's hurry and light it! We still need to find {NICKNAME}!

130270607.text: Wait, the Fire Seed! What happened?

130270609.text: It was even more unstable than I expected.

130270610.text: But why!? We barely used it!

130270611.text: I'm not sure. Perhaps the Fire Seed was only capable of protecting one person...?

130270612.text: But if I didn't use its power on everyone, there's no way of knowing where you could have been sucked into.

130270613.text: And even if that's the case... There's no reason for it to simply shatter... Unless...

130270615.text: Unless I was already in a weakened state when I created this Fire Seed...

130270616.text: Which would be when we had first saved the desert.

130270618.text: Wait, let's put that aside for a moment!

130270619.text: If the Fire Seed has shattered, wouldn't that mean we came all this way for nothing!?

130270620.text: *sigh* Do you know what we should do now, Nahida? C'mon, Paimon, think...!

130270622.text: Don't worry, Paimon. This is my responsibility. The Fire Seed is technically just a ball of highly concentrated elemental power.

130270623.text: Although my elemental power is slightly different than that of elemental life-forms, I gained a better understanding of it when I turned into a Fungus.

130270624.text: So, all I have to do is imitate that power while adding some of my own, and I'll be able to do what the Fire Seed was supposed to...

130270625.text: You're... gonna become the Fire Seed?

130270626.text: Yes. It'll take a lot of power from me, but it still won't be anything compared to when I was in the desert...

130270627.text: I might, however... become even smaller.

130270628.text: What happens if you keep getting smaller?

130270629.text: I'll become a blade of grass or a twig. Basically, I'll return to how I was first born.

130270630.text: I will be able to unleash power beyond my limits if I can reverse the process of growth.

130270631.text: But you'll lose everything! You'll not only lose your appearance, but you'll lose your emotions, memories, and who knows what else!

130270632.text: That's alright. None of that matters compared to the dangers that Apep is facing right now.

130270633.text: No, no, wait! There has to be another way! Besides, what will Sumeru do if you turn into a twig!?

130270634.text: #Maybe you and {NICKNAME} can plant me in the soil of Sumeru once it is all over.

130270635.text: I can still communicate with the world through the forest. It's just that you won't be able to see me for some time...

130270637.text: #If {NICKNAME} were here, {M#he}{F#she} definitely wouldn't let you go through with it!

130270638.text: If we knew this was how you were going to "take responsibility," then we never would've agreed in the first place!

130270639.text: I'm sorry, Paimon. But we're out of options.

130270640.text: Not all eagles who have fallen to the ground can soar in the sky once again. But if no risks are taken, then the eagle will be grounded forever.

130270301.text: Paimon thinks they've used up all their strength! They don't seem aggressive anymore...

130270303.text: Yes, it was never their intention to leave the Dendro Dragon.

130270304.text: Is there a way to make them revert to their elemental form?

130270305.text: Years of torment is what turned them into their current state. Their external form has become their shackles...

130270306.text: It seems only the Fire Seed or Apep's Heart of Oasis can save them.

130270307.text: But it'll be risky if we use the Fire Seed again.

130270308.text: Correct, we cannot use the Fire Seed again.

130270309.text: Everyone... goes... home. Not just... us.

130270310.text: Aw, this is becoming quite the dilemma...

130270311.text: Let me think for a second.

130270312.text: It's fine, let's use the power of the Fire Seed. I can't bear leaving them in the desert like this.

130270314.text: Don't worry. The decision is on me, I'll take responsibility for whatever happens.

130270315.text: It won't require much elemental power. I'm just worried that it'll become unstable.

130270316.text: But as long as I use my elemental power to stabilize it a little, it shouldn't be a problem.

130270319.text: Returning home is the most important thing to you. I've come to understand that during our travels.

130270320.text: I'm not doing this just to protect you, but also because I hope to use you and your experience and try speaking to Apep again.

130270321.text: After all, that giant Dendro Dragon is also your family. Maybe it would listen.

130270322.text: I will stand with you, Lord of Dendro. I will never forget your kindness.

130270324.text: Thank you. Alright, here it goes.

130270325.text: Family... We will all be able to go home soon.

130270328.text: Endless amounts of knowledge and emotions are moving inside of me. They're all very excited.

130270329.text: To imagine such growth could be achieved in such a short period of time...

130270330.text: It's because you're carrying everyone's hopes and dreams.

130270331.text: Yes, finally... we can go home.

130270332.text: This is the last part. Let's go.

130270401.text: This cave is huge! Could this be where the Dendro Dragon lives?

130270403.text: Yeah... Who knows what's inside that cave...

130270404.text: Our goal is not only to find the dragon, but to also enter the world inside of it.

130270405.text: That will be impossible if we can't get it to cooperate with us.

130270406.text: But how are we gonna do that? It doesn't seem to want to help at all.

130270407.text: I'll see what I can do.

130270408.text: Apep, I know we don't see eye to eye, and that we have a very different understanding of the world and its orders.

130270409.text: However, we are both born of elemental power and both suffered the torment of forbidden knowledge.

130270410.text: We are not that different. And right now, we share a common enemy. We should not let our differences get in the way.

130270411.text: Hmm, wonder if the Dendro Dragon's even willing to listen...

130270412.text: I don't care about what you believe in, who you hate, or what you've done in the name of hatred... Nor do I expect you to be grateful.

130270413.text: I'm here to save both you and your people. My people.

130270414.text: They've been searching for a way to save you ever since they left their homeland. They yearn for a chance to return home.

130270415.text: And now that everything is over, all the hatred that you harbor has lost its meaning. Rather than continuing to fight, you should consider the life you've produced.

130270418.text: Your eagerness to survive means that you haven't given up on that world yet!

130270419.text: If you claim to know so much more than I, then why don't you truly think about why you want to survive... and why you're so vengeful!

130270422.text: Wh—Whaaaa! Paimon is getting sucked in!

subQuests.subQuestName: Head to the Heart of Oasis

130270901.text: They're still here! Have they really been waiting here all this time?

130270905.text: I'm sorry, I really am... But it's gone home and won't be able to return for a very long time.

130270907.text: Don't be sad. It did it to protect you. Your happiness is more important to it than anything else in the world.

130270908.text: It said that "Nur" is its most important family member.

130270914.text: This is wonderful... So it has left traces of itself after all.

130270915.text: They will definitely meet again, someday.

subQuests.subQuestName: Confirm the situation at your current location

130270504.text: I was only able to ensure that we made it here safely. It's possible we arrived at different locations...

130270505.text: Hmm... Well, then let's go have a look up ahead. Paimon's feeling really worried...

130270506.text: #Yep, let's go. I wouldn't worry too much, {NICKNAME}'s no pushover.

130270507.text: Paimon knows that! It's just that Paimon isn't used to not having the Traveler around...

130270508.text: #Let's hurry! {M#He}{F#She} might be just up ahead.

subQuests.subQuestName: Witness the revival of the Heart of Oasis
Save the home of the elemental life-forms

130270701.text: Hey! Can you hear Paimon!? Say something!

130270702.text: You Fungi said that your form didn't matter, right? Then let us know that you're all right...!

130270705.text: Their knowledge, memories, and emotions have been reverted to elemental power and released. They are no longer able to respond to you.

130270706.text: The guardians that have accompanied me for countless eras have also transformed into my elemental power, just as they did.

130270707.text: They will be born once again now that they're one. There's nothing to be sad about.

130270708.text: But that's different! They won't ever be the same...

130270709.text: Paimon, we will never understand it, and it will never understand us. That's how it's destined to be.

130270710.text: But as long as you can be healthy again, then nothing else matters to me, Apep.

130270711.text: Sumeru will be free from threat as long as your health is maintained.

130270712.text: I thought that my rage would be kindled once my power returned to me.

130270713.text: However, what I feel now is a feeling that has long eluded me... the feeling of "peace."

130270714.text: The forbidden knowledge influenced you ever since you were contaminated, greatly amplifying your hatred and rage.

130270715.text: Yes... there's no denying that. Although my hatred for that usurper from beyond the heavens still stirs deep within me, destroying you and your people serves me no purpose.

130270716.text: Be that as it may, my position still stands, and I will have nothing to do with you.

130270717.text: When you inevitably perish due to your ever-expanding curiosity, I will still sneer and mock you in my heart.

130270718.text: Yeesh, who can put up with you?

130270719.text: I respect your decision, and with time, I will prove to you that we will not repeat our mistakes.

130270720.text: Before you begin resting, there is one last thing I would like to know.

130270721.text: How did you become affected by forbidden knowledge?

130270722.text: It's a long story... We all once believed in the distant past that only forbidden knowledge could give us enough power to defeat the Heavenly Principles.

130270723.text: The Drago{RUBY#[S]Nibelung}n King acquired the power of darkness from outside of this world and led us in a fight against the order established by the outsiders.

130270725.text: An unimaginable war took place in Teyvat, causing destruction on an unprecedented scale. The world itself was on the verge of collapse.

130270726.text: In war, the victor would inherit the right to shape the world, while the losers must turn into ash...

130270727.text: But I didn't give up on searching for a way to turn the tides, even after the death of the Dragon King.

130270728.text: As I attempted to collect more forbidden knowledge from the corners of the world as it was on the verge of collapse... I was stopped by the giant spike that fell from the sky.

130270729.text: Sand dunes arose where there was only forest, and it was as if even Sumeru itself was trying to tell me that the era of the dragons was over.

130270730.text: But you still didn't give up, did you? Because of Amun... Al-Ahmar.

130270731.text: Yes. Al-Ahmar eventually obtained this power\nwith the help of Nabu M{RUBY#[S]The Goddess of Flowers}alikata.

130270732.text: His ambitions continued to grow, and he planned to establish a powerful kingdom in my domain.

130270733.text: Although I didn't think much of him, I allowed his actions under one condition...

130270734.text: The condition was that after his death, all the knowledge he came to accumulate would belong to me.

130270735.text: At that time, I still harbored deep regrets. By the time the Dragon King finally returned, the world had irrevocably changed.

130270736.text: Some of the dragons have grown close to your kind and have forgotten all about our hatred from when the world was taken from us.

130270737.text: And some died, leaving behind nothing but their bones, while others chose to flee after experiencing pain and agony...

130270738.text: But for me, the scales and will of the Dragon King still shine bright in my heart even to this day.

130270739.text: I will follow them until the end of my time.

130270741.text: When Al-Ahmar's proud kingdom collapsed, I swallowed him whole as I agreed and absorbed his elemental power.

130270742.text: However, what I gained was no benefit... No, I gained the apocalypse.

130270743.text: I used up all my strength just trying to keep the pain under control... I had no energy to analyze the knowledge he had accumulated...

130270744.text: But even then, I still believe that his insanity was far greater than that of my own.

130270745.text: So that's how the apocalypse started...

130270746.text: I admit that I fell for his trap. I was like a final fail-safe in his plan.

130270747.text: Tiny Buer, and the rest of you... continue forward. I shall keep a watchful eye.

130270748.text: How far will the life so dear and precious to the Heavenly Principles be able to go? I wonder...

130270801.text: Hey! Looks like we've been sent back out... Still in one piece, too!

130270802.text: The dragon will need to rest for a very long time before it is fully healthy again.

130270803.text: It's not as ruthless as it was before. Curing the dragon of its illness has seemingly made it more open to reason.

130270804.text: Nobody's in a good mood when they're feeling sick!

130270805.text: Even though we accomplished something really important, Paimon still doesn't feel happy for some reason.

130270808.text: Indeed, although they'll still have the chance to be born again, they've lost their memories of their journey and their feelings for their homeland.

130270809.text: Each opportunity for growth is unique in its own way.

130270810.text: Perhaps the immense power we released was the pouring out of all these irreplaceable emotions that had built up over time.

130270811.text: Can you really call a place with no family your home...?

130270812.text: Family... Right! The Hydro Fungus left behind its family.

130270813.text: Those two Fungi might be waiting for it to return.

130270814.text: Oh, yeah! Let's hurry and go take a look. How are we going to explain all the complicated things that happened...?

subQuests.subQuestName: Go back outside Sumeru City and seek out the Fungi

130191803.text: I'm moved that they were so worried about me.

130199910.text: (I can sense its excitement from seeing its fellow Fungus wake back up.)

130199911.text: (It seems to have let out a long sigh of relief...)

130199928.text: (It's happy because it found some delicious fruit.)

130199929.text: (It looks like it's in a good mood, and is waiting for another Fungus.)

130199930.text: (It looks really sleepy. Why doesn't it go to sleep?)

130199931.text: (It looks like it's very curious about us.)

130199932.text: (It appears to be encouraging itself. Is it about to face some kind of formidable foe?)

130199933.text: (It seems to be welcoming us as guests.)

130279902.text: Looks like we'll have to clear out the Oozing Filth in this area. You two should be able to take care of it, right?

130279903.text: Yep, we know what to do. We'll just use the Lumenstone on the Oozing Concretion!

130279905.text: I can feel its power lingering and shifting around us. Sometimes it feels distant, but other times it seems close. This is its way of warning us.

130279918.text: It has already noticed our presence.

130279906.text: To imagine such growth could be achieved in such a short period of time...

130279907.text: It's because you're carrying everyone's hopes and dreams.

130279908.text: Yes, finally... we can go home.

130279910.text: Thank you for protecting me with your elemental power. Goodbye...

130279913.text: I will wait for her no matter how long it takes. This is the agreement we made.

130279914.text: I learned a wonderful word. It's "Nur," which means "light."

130279915.text: It will be your name from now on.

130279917.text: Good, sounds like you like it.
